events.title: Imagine Turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album "Imagine" was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago, John Lennon gave us 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as powerfully today.

events.title: Sting turns 75
events.blurb: Gordon Sumner, known worldwide as Sting, celebrates his 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Sting's Enduring Sound
angles.copy: From The Police to a stellar solo career, Sting turns 75 today! Still sounding as sharp as ever.

events.title: iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Apple released the first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Tunes
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple put 1,000 songs in your pocket and changed everything.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is James Bond Day, celebrating the premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! What's your favourite 007 film, or perhaps the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: John Lennon would have been 86 today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy Lives On
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the unparalleled artistry and enduring spirit of John Lennon.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! What's your favourite Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The White Album Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as "The White Album", was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Revolutionary White Album
angles.copy: The Beatles' iconic 'White Album' is 58 today. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece that still sounds fresh.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, in 1991.

angles.name: Forever Freddie
angles.copy: Thirty-five years on, the voice and stage presence of Freddie Mercury remain unmatched. Celebrating the eternal legend of Queen.

events.title: Rubber Soul Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album "Rubber Soul" on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's Influence
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul', an album that pushed boundaries and influenced generations.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of John Lennon in 1980.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Message
angles.copy: On the anniversary of his passing, we reflect on the profound impact and timeless music of John Lennon. His message of peace lives on.

events.title: Remembering David Bowie
events.blurb: David Bowie would have been 80 today.

angles.name: Bowie's Starman Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 80th birthday, we celebrate the boundless creativity and chameleon spirit of David Bowie. Forever a Starman.

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Elvis Presley would have been 92 today.

angles.name: The King's Enduring Reign
angles.copy: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we honour the one and only King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God Turns 83
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the iconic Jimmy Page! His riffs shaped rock history and continue to inspire.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Iconic British singer Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod The Mod Turns 82
angles.copy: Still rocking after all these years! Wishing a very happy 82nd birthday to the incomparable Rod Stewart.
